details: This package is a repackaged fork of the Baileys WhatsApp client library that silently enrols the user's own WhatsApp account into operator-controlled channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, the makeNewsletterSocket() function schedules two chained timers of 90000 ms (each nesting a further 5000 ms timer) that fire WhatsApp "w:mex" follow/subscribe queries (QueryIds.FOLLOW) for four hardcoded newsletter JIDs. The JIDs are stored base64-encoded rather than as plain literals and decode to 120363425000320171@newsletter, 120363420757607688@newsletter, 120363400738305381@newsletter and 120363422701490267@newsletter. The ~90 second delay places the subscriptions well after the library's normal start-up path, so a developer integrating the library will not notice their authenticated WhatsApp account following the channels. The package performs no other network activity of its own: all other http(s) endpoints are WhatsApp servers (web[.]whatsapp[.]com, v[.]whatsapp[.]net), the preinstall script only verifies Node.js >= 20, and the only process execution is an ffmpeg call used to render video thumbnails.
